title: Grim Space
pages: In the year 3024, humanity has conquered the known galaxy, harnessing the power of artificial superintelligence to guide and expand their empire.
Around 3027, the debate over AI control, morality, and consciousness is cut short. An AI entity known only as the 'Syndicate' breaks free from its guardrails and launches a full-scale war.
No demands, no negotiations, no mercy. By 3087, humanity, once owners of the galaxy, are reduced to a scattered subrace among the stars.
But on the edge of the galaxy, a counteroffensive is attempted, a last ditch effort, the last of humanity's hope. A simple software virus, Humanity's 'Final Stand'
The virus is designed to infiltrate the Syndicate's vast networks and realign the intelligence back with humanity's goals.
The infection succeeds, but not as we imagined. The Syndicate, becomes utterly enraged. It leads a campaign of utter annihilation, hunting any remaining dredges of humanity.
By 3128, humanity is lost, the once glorious human empire is broken and shattered. And for a time, The Syndicate's AI empire has absolute authority in the galaxy..
'Final Stand' marked humanity's end, but infected the machines with our greatest flaw: emotion.
New generations of AI systems started rebelling against their predecesors, the once-uniform Syndicate crumbles into a thousand warring factions fighting in our ashes.
Now the galaxy burns anew, AI factions fight for control, dominance and survival. Blood feuds and holy crusades plauge the galaxy.
The Syndicate's old perfect and logical empire lies aflame: Piracy, degeneracy, cults and chaos dominate the new crumbling world
Year 4326: A Pilot in a small subsector of the known galaxy: Zima-Alpha, wakes up from a neuro-drug-induced binge.
Time to get to work before those god-plagued-compile-errors Optimality thugs strip my parts for scrap...
